title: Install 29 typo-RAM u-suffix units that were QEMU-ARC EQUIVALENT 100 with killed mutants; private p-usuf29 rebuild; paired Renode sims PASS. Two 80542c units held back for array-bounds / overlapping objects.
scope: Workspace rewrite of leftover 0x80xxxxu / UINT32_C typo-RAM literals onto existing em9305_ram.h objects (no new header or ld objects). Prove vs current tree C, mutant-kill check, install only non-vacuous EQUIVALENT units whose mutants were caught, private p-lowers rebuild, NVM slot-fit, private NOR splice, both paired sims.

rewrite.note: Address-as-value or field access onto existing typo-RAM objects. Pinned ranges and some leftover literals left alone.

prove.not_yet_proven_note: Held as hook/IRQ/boot/sleep/helper units or not yet run. Largest remaining include controller_timer_helpers.c (17 sites), wsf_os_ao.c (19), application_boot.c (20), AOAD_Init.c (12), IRQ handlers, and sleep_*.

mutants.compile_fail_cause: First mutate() renamed &em9305_ram_X to a missing &em9305_ram_X+4 object. Patched to a compile-safe ((uintptr_t)&em9305_ram_X + 4u).
mutants.survived_cause: Mutating ((uintptr_t)&em9305_ram_801090 + 0x8u) to +0xcu was not observable when both typo-RAM pointer words were unusable; test-only pre_seed_801090.h (not in the tree) plants distinct objects and magics at 0x801098 vs 0x80109c. Shared lowers/chunks/spec.json was not written; a private spec_mutants.json was used.

install.held_back_reason: Installed rewrite used W32((uintptr_t)&em9305_ram_80542c) and W32(base+0x10/0x14/0x18). gcc -Werror=array-bounds: em9305_ram_80542c is a 1-byte harvested object. Stock uses a 28-byte (0x1c) scratch at 0x80542c (init_native_callback_3286f8 memset 0x1c; lctrSlvBigBeginOp comment; completion files access +0..+0x18). Growing to 0x1c would overlap existing typo-RAM objects em9305_ram_805434 (at +8) and em9305_ram_805438 (at +0xc), which already have users (lctrSlvBisSetupTxData, init_native_callback_328dd4). Header and ld were not grown or merged this pass. Those two units were written back to their pre-install literal C (HEAD sha256 matches install sha256_before). The other 29 units stayed installed.

tree_build.cache_note: objcache is keyed by sha256(source+headers+flags). The earlier failed p-usuf build had already compiled the 29 new units; this run recompiled only the two reverted literal units and final-linked.

splice.nor_source: copy of build/em9305-nor-20261122/nor-stock-formatted.bin, then lfs_inject at 0x1400000 path /firmware/ble_em9305.bin
